formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiCF3SO3 system characterized by WAXS, optical microscopy, and ac conductivity. Intermediate compound stoichiometry appears to be less than 4:1 (approx 3.5:1).
formulations.Notes: High molecular weight PEO (900 K) used. Salt dried at 100-110°C. Electrolytes stored in glove box at 25°C.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiCF3SO3 system characterized by WAXS, optical microscopy, and ac conductivity. Intermediate compound stoichiometry appears to be less than 4:1 (approx 3.5:1). Eutectic composition around O/Li = 100. Two-phase system at T > 60°C for salt mass fractions > 0.05.
formulations.Notes: High molecular weight PEO (900 K) supplied by Aldrich.
formulations.Reference: C. D. Robitaille and D. Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986)

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiCF3SO3 system characterized by WAXS, optical microscopy, and ac conductivity. Intermediate compound stoichiometry determined as less than 4:1 (O/Li).
formulations.Notes: PEO molecular weight 900 kDa. Salt dried at 100-110 C. Conductivity measured over 25-130 C. Activation energy ~0.7 eV for T > 60 C. Intermediate compound stoichiometry < 4:1.
formulations.Reference: C. D. Robitaille and D. Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986)

formulations.Notes: PEO8LiClO4 mixture is totally amorphous at temperatures above the PEO melting temperature. The system forms intermediate compounds P(EO6LiClO4) and P(EO3LiClO4).
formulations.Reference: Robitaille and Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986)

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiAsF6 system forms intermediate compounds P(EO6LiAsF6) and P(EO3LiAsF6). Eutectic between P(EO6LiAsF6) and pure PEO at ~55°C. P(EO6LiAsF6) melts at 136°C. Electrolytes with higher salt content than PEO5LiAsF6 are thermally unstable.
formulations.Notes: PEO-LiAsF6 system forms intermediate compounds P(EO6LiAsF6) and P(EO3LiAsF6). Eutectic between P(EO6LiAsF6) and pure PEO at ~55°C. P(EO6LiAsF6) melts at 136°C. Electrolytes with higher salt content than PEO5LiAsF6 are thermally unstable.
formulations.Reference: C. D. Robitaille and D. Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986)

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO-LiAsF6 system forms intermediate compounds P(EO6LiAsF6) and P(EO3LiAsF6). Eutectic temperature ~55°C. Electrolytes with salt content > PEO5LiAsF6 are thermally unstable (blackening, conductivity increase >90°C).
formulations.Notes: PEO high molecular weight (900 K). Salt LiAsF6 recrystallized in acetonitrile. Intermediate compound stoichiometry P(EO3LiAsF6) confirmed by WAXS and DSC. Phase diagram shows eutectic between PEO and P(EO6LiAsF6).
formulations.Reference: C. D. Robitaille and D. Fauteux, J. Electrochem. Soc., 133, 315 (1986).
